notes.title: Update 1.0
notes.notes: First of all, thank you for playing and sharing your experiences and feedback with us. We noticed that many of you had performance issues, especially during the mountain level. Therefore, we have been working on an update to improve those parts of the game. You will also notice improved visuals and performance throughout the game.

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Letzte Worte
notes.notes:
We’re happy to announce the full release of our free-to-play title [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/932800/Letzte_Worte_VR/][b]Letzte Worte[/b][/url] on Steam. All you need is a room-scale HTC Vive or 360° Oculus Touch setup. 

Trapped in a strange shattered world lost in fog, you take a trip down memory lane. The past not only hides memories of your relationship between you and your brother, but also the suppressed event that may has led to his suicide. Face your deepest fear in this built-for-VR adventure.
